claims.label: Section 3.1: previous algorithm

claims.label: Section 3: unrestricted faithfulness of a maximal coset action
claims.qualification: Faithfulness holds when the maximal subgroup has trivial core, including the twelve nonabelian simple groups.
claims.attribution: Core identity is classical; the explicit diagnosis and witness belong to this treatment.

claims.label: Algorithm 3.1: undefined K variable

claims.attribution: Printed pseudocode is quoted by position, with this diagnosis attributed to this treatment.
